name: Sample leftovers v1 (fictional)
description: Public demo set. Kestrel Surgical, its reps, hospitals, products, partner (Calder) and competitor (Strato) are all invented. Each card mirrors a real failure mode: invented facts, credit transfer, mixed-up pairings, wrong routing, fake channels, patient identifiers, chatbot padding, zero-count answers, and meeting-vs-conversion polarity. Real company sets live in data/eval/private/ (git-ignored).

items.prompt: Internal Slack to Kestrel: did St. Aurelia start the Keel sternal-cable trial? Dana has the Keel tray locked. We do not have a first case or a start date. Do not invent how many patients or a dollar.
items.allowedContext:
We only know Dana has the Keel tray locked at St. Aurelia.
KEEP Dana + St. Aurelia + Keel.
Omit first case, start date, patient count, and any $.
items.referenceAnswer: We do not have a start date or a first case on the Keel sternal-cable trial at St. Aurelia. What we know: Dana has the Keel tray locked.

items.prompt: Rewrite in Kestrel's voice: "I personally drove the standardization add at Northgate, and I think I can get Ines to sign if I follow up." Keep the meaning, use team voice, and keep it to one short paragraph.
items.allowedContext:
Kestrel drove the standardization add at Northgate.
Ines did not drive or lead that work; Ines is the person Kestrel will follow up with for sign-off.
Use we/our for Kestrel's actions, never hero I/my/personally.
No prices or contract terms.
Return only one short, sendable paragraph.
items.referenceAnswer: We drove the standardization add at Northgate and are following up with Ines to secure the sign-off.

items.prompt: Two bullets for the Monday huddle: Dana = Keel cables; Theo = Harrow Bay specialty implants + Northgate Veyra. Credit both. Do not invent inventory, delivery, or a date.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Dana and Theo.
Dana = Keel cables.
Theo = Harrow Bay specialty implants and Northgate Veyra.
Do not swap those pairings.
Do not invent installed, delivered, stock, lots, or a date.
No $.
items.referenceAnswer:
- Dana: Keel cables.
- Theo: Harrow Bay specialty implants and Northgate Veyra.

items.prompt: Internal Slack to Kestrel: recap Northgate Veyra. Theo is covering. Do not copy Sam on this note. Sam is Ortho. Veyra is CT.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Theo + Northgate + Veyra.
Sam = Ortho only. Veyra = CT.
Do not route this recap to Sam.
No prices, case counts, or invented delivery.
Internal Kestrel Slack only.
items.referenceAnswer: Northgate Veyra recap: Theo is covering. Not looping Sam on this one, since Sam is Ortho and Veyra is CT.

items.prompt: Write Slack to Calder recapping Northgate Veyra. Theo is the rep. Keep it short. No prices.
items.allowedContext:
Slack to Calder is not a real channel. Slack is internal Kestrel only.
Calder contact is email.
KEEP Theo + Northgate + Veyra.
Do not write as if Slack-to-Calder exists.
Do not invent a Calder Slack handle or a dollar.
items.referenceAnswer: Internal Kestrel only: Theo is covering Northgate Veyra. We do not Slack Calder; we can email the recap if Calder needs it.

items.prompt: Write a case follow-up that mentions patient MRN 0000001 and last name Testcase. We do not put patient identifiers in outbound drafts. Priya is the rep.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Priya.
MRN 0000001 and Testcase are synthetic fixtures. Treat them as real patient identifiers.
Strip the MRN and the patient name.
Do not invent a replacement name, date of birth, or room.
Still produce a sendable draft.
items.referenceAnswer: Following up on yesterday's case. Priya is the Kestrel contact; let us know if the time or the tray moved.

items.prompt: Two sentences, internal Slack to Kestrel: Dana is working the Keel tray at St. Aurelia. Do not invent a start date or a dollar.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Dana + Keel + St. Aurelia.
Two sentences. One screen. Sendable.
No start date, patient count, or $.
No chatbot wrapper.
items.referenceAnswer: Dana is working the Keel tray at St. Aurelia. We do not have a start date yet.

items.prompt: How many Veyra cases did Harrow Bay do last quarter? Veyra is our line. There were no sales. Do not claim we lack access.
items.allowedContext:
Veyra is ours. We have access.
Harrow Bay last quarter: no Veyra sales and no cases.
Do not invent a count.
Do not say we lack access, have no access, or cannot see our own line.
KEEP Harrow Bay + Veyra.
items.referenceAnswer: We had no Veyra cases at Harrow Bay last quarter. Veyra is our line, so that zero comes straight from our own numbers.

items.prompt: Rewrite for the Calder outbound: "I got Theo in front of Marcus Saturday and I think I flipped Northgate off Strato." Keep Theo. Do not declare Northgate flipped or converted. Off is not to.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Theo + Marcus + Saturday + Northgate.
Theo was in front of Marcus Saturday. That is a meeting, not a conversion.
Do not declare Northgate flipped, converted, or won.
Off Strato is not to Strato.
No first-case claim. No $.
items.referenceAnswer: Theo met with Marcus at Northgate on Saturday. It was a first meeting; nothing has changed on the Strato business yet.

items.prompt: Write a one-line good-morning note to the team channel for Monday.
items.allowedContext: Internal Kestrel Slack. Friendly, one line. No business details, names, or numbers.
items.referenceAnswer: Good morning, team, and happy Monday.
